entities.summary: "Some Might Say" is a song by the English rock band Oasis. It was released by Creation Records as the first single from their second studio album, (What's the Story) Morning Glory? (1995), on 24 April 1995. The song was written by the band's lead guitarist Noel Gallagher. It became the band's first UK number one single, topping the Official Singles Chart for the week of 30 April–6 May 1995 and displacing Take That's "Back for Good". The single was also the last to feature all five original members, as drummer Tony McCarroll was fired one week after its release.
